sections.title: Overseas departments: octroi de mer and octroi de mer régional

rows.label: Legal basis
rows.value: Loi n° 2004-639 du 2 juillet 2004 relative à l'octroi de mer, amended by loi n° 2015-762 du 29 juin 2015

rows.label: What is taxed
rows.value: Imports of goods whatever their origin (octroi de mer externe) and deliveries of goods made for consideration by producers (octroi de mer interne); imports are taxed on their customs value

rows.label: Local producers: outside the tax with annual production turnover below
Who sets the rates
rows.value: Deliberations of the regional councils (the conseil général in Mayotte), which may also levy an octroi de mer régional on the same base; a rate gap between local and imported goods is allowed for a limited list of products

rows.label: Guadeloupe and Martinique: octroi de mer (indicative)
rows.value: 7% to 15%, some goods 20%, 25% or even 50%; octroi de mer régional 1.5% or 2.5% (Conseil régional de Guadeloupe, Collectivité territoriale de Martinique)

rows.source_title: Légifrance: Code général des impôts, article 219 (version en vigueur depuis le 21 février 2026, modifié par la loi n° 2026-103 du 19 février 2026, art. 15); Entreprendre Service Public F23575, Impôt sur les sociétés (vérifié le 17 février 2026)

rows.value: 25%; 15% on the first €42,500 of profit for companies with turnover up to €10,000,000; plus 3.3% social contribution above €763,000 of tax, an exceptional contribution of 20.6% or 41.2% of the tax for turnover from €1,000,000,000 (two years from 31 December 2025) and a 15% global minimum tax for groups with turnover of €750,000,000 or more. Paid by companies subject to corporate tax. CGI art. 219, 235 ter ZC and 223 VJ to 223 WZ; finance law for 2025 art. 48 and for 2026 art. 12.

Paid by businesses engaging self-employed people (concealed employment otherwise). Code du travail L8221-6; portage salarial L1254-1 and L1254-2.

rows.label: Withholding on payments to non-resident contractors [national]
rows.value: 25% on fees for services supplied or used in France (15% sports, 75% for non-cooperative states). Paid by non-residents without a permanent base in France (withheld by the payer). CGI art. 182 B.

rows.label: Simplified regimes: micro-BIC, micro-BNC, micro-social and VAT franchise [national]
rows.value: turnover up to €203,100 (sales) or €83,600 (services), flat allowance of 71%, 50% or 34%; no VAT below €85,000 or €37,500. Paid by sole traders and freelancers who use them. CGI art. 50-0, 102 ter, 151-0 and 293 B. In force from 1 July 2026.

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income [national]
rows.value: withholding of 0%, 12% and 20% on pay (2026 limits €17,275 and €50,112), credited against income tax at minimum rates of 20% and 30% unless the worldwide average rate is lower. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). CGI art. 4 B (residence), 182 A and 197 A. In force from 1 January 2026.

rows.label: Property tax (taxe foncière sur les propriétés bâties) [local]
rows.value: rates voted by communes and intercommunalities: national average 39.79% in 2025, ceiling 99.48% for 2026, on half of the cadastral rental value. Paid by owners of built property on 1 January. CGI art. 1380 and following. In force from 1 January 2026.

rows.label: Property transfer tax (droits de mutation à titre onéreux) [département and commune]
rows.value: département duty 3.8% to 5% (88 départements at 5%), plus 1.2% communal tax and a State charge of 2.37% of the département duty. Paid by the buyer. CGI art. 1594 D, 1584 and 1647; finance law for 2025 art. 116.

rows.section: Taxes, levies and charges: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item A2; detailed table: surcharge-high-incomes
rows.source_title: Service-Public.fr: Qui doit payer la contribution exceptionnelle sur les hauts revenus ? (vérifié le 15 avril 2026)
rows.label: Surcharges on income tax: high-income contributions (CEHR, CDHR) [national]
rows.value: CEHR 3% and 4% on reference income above €250,000 (single) or €500,000 (couple); CDHR tops tax up to an average 20% above the same thresholds. Paid by high-income households. Code général des impôts (contribution exceptionnelle and contribution différentielle sur les hauts revenus).

rows.section: Taxes, levies and charges: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item A5; detailed table: capital-gains
rows.source_title: Service-Public.fr: Impôt sur le revenu - Revenus d'épargne et de placement, revenus 2026 (vérifié le 15 avril 2026)
rows.label: Capital gains tax for individuals: flat tax (PFU) and property gains (prélèvement forfaitaire unique, plus-values immobilières) [national]
rows.value: Securities: 12.8% income tax plus 18.6% social levies from 2026 (31.4%); property: 19% plus 17.2% social levies, main home exempt, exempt after 22 years (income tax) and 30 years (social levies), extra 2% to 6% on gains above €50,000. Paid by individuals. Code général des impôts (prélèvement forfaitaire unique, plus-values immobilières); social levies under the Code de la sécurité sociale.

rows.section: Taxes, levies and charges: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: withholding-investment
rows.source_title: impots.gouv.fr: Mes dividendes (non-résidents; publié le 31/03/2016, modifié le 26/02/2026)
rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends paid to non-residents (retenue à la source) [national]
rows.value: 12.8% for individuals (rate on 1 January 2026); 75% where paid in a non-cooperative state; no social levies for non-residents. Paid by non-resident shareholders (withheld by the paying institution). Code général des impôts (retenue à la source on investment income); tax treaties.

rows.section: Taxes, levies and charges: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item A7; detailed table: rental-income
rows.source_title: Service-Public.fr: Revenus fonciers (location vide) : régime micro-foncier ou réel (vérifié le 15 avril 2026)
rows.label: Rental income and pension income [national]
rows.value: Micro-foncier with a 30% allowance for rents up to €15,000, otherwise actual costs (deficit up to €10,700 against total income); pensions after a 10% deduction (€454 to €4,439). Paid by landlords and pensioners. Code général des impôts (revenus fonciers; art. 158 for pensions).

rows.section: Taxes, levies and charges: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item B2; detailed table: employer-taxes
rows.source_title: Entreprendre.Service-Public.fr: Taxe sur les salaires (vérifié le 01 janvier 2026)
rows.label: Payroll tax (taxe sur les salaires) and transport levy (versement mobilité) [national and municipal]
rows.value: Taxe sur les salaires 4.25%, 8.50% and 13.60% by pay band for employers not liable to VAT; versement mobilité at the local authority's rate for employers with 11 or more employees; regional VMRR up to 0.15%. Paid by employers. Code général des impôts (taxe sur les salaires); versement mobilité and VMRR (finance law for 2025).

rows.section: Taxes, levies and charges: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item B4
rows.source_title: Agirc-Arrco: Cotisations au régime Agirc-Arrco en 2026
rows.label: Mandatory occupational pension: Agirc-Arrco complementary pension [national]
rows.value: 7.87% on pay up to the social security ceiling (4.72% employer, 3.15% employee), higher rates on tranche 2. Paid by employers and employees in the private sector. Agirc-Arrco complementary pension scheme (compulsory contribution rates).

rows.section: Taxes, levies and charges: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item C2; detailed table: local-business-tax

rows.label: Local business taxes: CFE and CVAE (cotisation foncière des entreprises, cotisation sur la valeur ajoutée des entreprises) [municipal]
rows.value: CFE at the commune's rate on the rental value of business property (minimum base set locally); CVAE 0% to 0.19% of value added in 2026 and 2027, none below €500,000 turnover. Paid by businesses. Code général des impôts (cotisation foncière des entreprises and cotisation sur la valeur ajoutée des entreprises).

rows.note: Checklist item D1; detailed table: vat-rates
rows.source_title: economie.gouv.fr: TVA : quels sont les taux de votre quotidien ? (écrit le 11/12/2025)
rows.label: VAT (TVA): standard, reduced and special rates [national]
rows.value: 20% standard; 10% and 5.5% reduced; 2.1% special; Corsica and overseas departments have their own rates (8.5% standard in Guadeloupe, Martinique and La Réunion). Paid by consumers (charged by businesses). Code général des impôts (taxe sur la valeur ajoutée).

rows.source_title: douane.gouv.fr: Droits des alcools et boissons alcooliques (mise à jour le 08/10/2026)
rows.label: Excise duties: alcohol and energy products (accises) [national]
rows.value: Spirits €1,932.42 per hl of pure alcohol plus €620.47 social security contribution above 18%; beer €8.24 per hl per degree; still wine €4.19 per hl; diesel €60.75 and petrol €69.02 per hl. Paid by producers and importers (passed on in prices). Code des impositions sur les biens et services art. L. 313-15 to L. 313-25 and L. 312-41; Code de la sécurité sociale art. L. 245-9.

rows.label: Electricity excise (energy tax) (accise sur l'électricité) [national]
rows.value: €30.62 per MWh for households from 1 August 2026 (€30.85 from February to July 2026); €26.35 for larger businesses. Paid by electricity consumers (collected by suppliers). Code des impositions sur les biens et services (accise sur l'électricité; surcharge of art. L. 312-37-1).

rows.source_title: Service-Public.fr: Calcul de l'impôt sur la fortune immobilière (IFI) (vérifié le 06 mars 2026)
rows.label: Wealth tax: real estate wealth tax (impôt sur la fortune immobilière (IFI)) [national]
rows.value: 0.5% to 1.5% of net real estate assets above €800,000, due only where they exceed €1,300,000. Paid by households with net real estate assets above €1.3 million. Code général des impôts (impôt sur la fortune immobilière).

rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax (droits de succession et de donation) [national]
rows.value: Direct line 5% to 45% after a €100,000 allowance; spouse and PACS partner exempt on inheritance; siblings 35% and 45%; relatives to the fourth degree 55%; others 60%. Paid by heirs and gift recipients. Code général des impôts (droits de succession et de donation).

rows.label: Vehicle taxes: malus penalties and the registration certificate tax (malus, certificat d'immatriculation) [national]
rows.value: CO2 malus from €50 at 108 g/km to €80,000 above 191 g/km; mass malus €10 to €30 per kg above 1,500 kg; registration: €11 fixed tax plus a regional tax. Paid by buyers registering a car. Code des impositions sur les biens et services (taxes on motor vehicles).

rows.value: Set by communes per person and night by category; 1% to 5% of the night's price for unclassified accommodation; +200% in Île-de-France. Paid by guests (collected by hosts). Taxe de séjour voted by communes and intercommunalities.

rows.value: €3 duty per item on consignments up to €150 from 1 July 2026; traveller allowance €430 (air and sea) or €300; cash of €10,000 or more must be declared. Paid by importers and travellers. EU customs law (Council Regulation (EU) 2026/382); Code des douanes.

rows.value: None: abolished for all taxpayers from 2022. Paid by no one. Abolished from 2022.
